name: Underglaze transfer printing
summary: A pattern is printed from an engraved copper plate on thin paper. The paper is rubbed on to the biscuit ware and the glaze covers the print.
how: Engrave the design on a copper plate.
Fill the lines with cobalt colour and print on tissue paper.
Rub the tissue on to the biscuit piece and wash off the paper.

origin.note: English potters print cobalt blue patterns under the glaze from engraved plates.

adoptions.via: Staffordshire potters print the willow pattern in blue on cheap earthenware plates from one copper plate.
